title: Herald of Ice Guide — Cold Aura, Shatter Explosion and Spirit
summary: Herald of Ice is a Herald (aura) skill: it grants you extra cold damage, and when a frozen enemy dies (shatters), it triggers an icy explosion dealing cold damage to nearby enemies. This guide explains how it competes for Spirit, the shatter-explosion trigger condition, the loop with Ice Shot / Freezing Mark, how it differs from Herald of Thunder / Ash, and why it is the clear core of frost bow builds.
description: Herald of Ice deep guide: aura bonus and shatter-explosion mechanic, Spirit reservation, comparison with other Heralds, recommended duration / area / cold supports, Ice Shot Deadeye role, shatter-not-triggering and Spirit-over-budget causes with direct answers, video timestamps and real community questions.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial

sections.title: Overview: Aura Buff + Shatter Chain
paragraphs: Herald of Ice is a Herald (aura) skill: once active it grants you a layer of extra cold damage (your attacks and spells carry more cold), and crucially — when a frozen enemy dies (shatters), it triggers an icy explosion dealing cold damage to nearby enemies. It is a dual tool of 'buff + on-kill chain'.

Its clear logic is elegant: you freeze mobs with cold skills, frozen mobs shatter on death, and the shatter triggers an ice explosion that freezes / damages the surrounding pack — forming a 'freeze → die → shatter → explode → re-freeze' snowball. This is exactly why it is the clear core of frost bow builds.

The cost is Spirit: Herald skills reserve Spirit (competing with Persistent Buffs / other Heralds / trigger gems for budget). In Spirit-tight builds, whether to run Herald of Ice is often a trade-off between 'clear efficiency' and 'other core auras'.
bullets: Essence: aura bonus (extra cold) + shatter explosion (on-kill chain).
Clear logic: freeze → die → shatter → explode → re-freeze, snowball.
Cost: reserves Spirit, competes with other Heralds / trigger gems.
Common partners: Ice Shot / Freezing Mark frost systems.

sections.title: Mechanics: How the Shatter Explosion Triggers
paragraphs: Trigger condition: the shatter explosion only happens on 'frozen enemy death'. That is, you must freeze the target first, then kill it, for the shatter to trigger the ice explosion. If you kill without freezing, a normal death does NOT trigger Herald of Ice's explosion — the most common newbie miss.

Explosion effect: the shatter-triggered ice explosion deals cold damage to nearby enemies, and the explosion itself can also freeze / advance freeze buildup on surrounding enemies, so neighbors get frozen easier after the blast, freeze then die then explode — a chain. In dense packs this can clear the screen in one go.

Bonus part: Herald of Ice also adds cold damage to your attacks / spells, so even without relying on shatter, keeping it on steadily boosts your cold output. It is a combo of 'passive cold damage + active shatter chain'.
bullets: Shatter explosion only on 'frozen enemy death'; normal death no trigger.
Explosion deals cold to nearby and can freeze / advance them, chaining.
Always-on also adds cold; passive cold + active shatter combo.

sections.title: Comparison: Herald of Ice vs Other Heralds

supports.label: Cold Infusion / Added Cold
notes: Amplifies the cold bonus Herald provides and the shatter explosion's cold damage.

supports.label: Magnified Area
notes: Enlarges shatter explosion radius so the chain covers more enemies — a clear-quality change.
Many frost builds treat it as mandatory for the Herald.

supports.label: Increased Duration (if on aura)
notes: If the client allows extending aura / effect duration, it cuts re-cast frequency.
Confirm current client maps it onto Herald.

supports.label: Spell Cascade
notes: If the shatter explosion counts as a spell effect, Cascade can widen its reach.

supports.label: Energy Retention / Spirit (if available)
notes: If the client offers a Spirit-cost-reducing support, it eases the budget pressure.

supports.label: Elemental Focus
notes: Amplifies cold damage but drops elemental ailment status; confirm you don't care about non-freeze ailments.
If the shatter chain relies on freeze status, use Elemental Focus cautiously.

sections.title: Role in Builds
paragraphs: Clear engine of Ice Shot Deadeye: the frost bow uses Ice Shot to spread chill and freeze; Herald of Ice turns 'frozen mob dies → explode' into the norm, and with Freezing Mark freezing key targets faster — closing the loop 'mark → freeze → die → shatter → explode' clear.

Relation to freeze-trigger / shatter builds: any build relying on Freeze to trigger or on shatter to clear directly benefits from Herald of Ice's steady shatter explosions. It is the lever that scales 'single-target freeze' into 'area ice burst'.

Spirit budget trade-off: in Spirit-tight builds, running Herald of Ice may squeeze out other core auras or trigger gems. Then you must weigh whether 'shatter clear payoff' exceeds the squeezed-out aura value; if needed, use Spirit-reducing supports or swap gear.
bullets: Ice Shot Deadeye: Herald as shatter clear engine, loop clear.
Serves freeze-trigger / shatter builds, scaling area ice burst.
Spirit-tight: weigh shatter payoff vs squeezed-out auras.

sections.title: Common Mistakes: No Shatter / Spirit Over Budget
paragraphs: Shatter won't trigger: you killed a non-frozen mob (normal death), so no explosion. Direct answer: freeze first then kill; use Ice Shot / Freezing Mark to ensure the target is frozen before the finishing blow.
Explosion no coverage: shatter explosion has a radius; too-spread mobs don't fill it. Direct answer: use Magnified Area to enlarge radius, or gather mobs before clearing.

Spirit over budget: you run Herald of Ice plus another Herald / trigger gem and Spirit blows out, disabling skills. Direct answer: reallocate Spirit, keep core auras first, or use Spirit-reducing supports.

Expecting it to freeze bosses: bosses usually aren't cleared by the shatter mechanic; shatter explosion has limited value on a solo boss. Direct answer: Herald of Ice shines in clear, don't rely on it for boss single-target.
bullets: Direct answer: freeze then kill; normal death no trigger.
Direct answer: enlarge area or gather mobs before clear.
Direct answer: reallocate Spirit, keep core auras first.

items.question: Why don't kills produce an ice explosion?
answer: The shatter explosion only triggers on 'frozen enemy death'; normal death does not trigger.
Direct answer: freeze first then kill; use Ice Shot / Freezing Mark to ensure freeze.

items.question: Does Herald of Ice reserve a lot of Spirit?
answer: High. It competes with other Heralds / Persistent Buffs / trigger gems for Spirit budget.
When Spirit is tight, weigh it or use Spirit-reducing supports.

items.question: Is it useful on bosses?
answer: Limited. Bosses usually aren't cleared by the shatter mechanic; shatter explosion has low value on a solo boss.
Herald of Ice's real strength is dense-pack clearing.
